ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word has the short vowel /ʌ/? (1 mark)
   A. floor
   B. sport
   C. mother
   D. door

2. An open-ended composition (1 mark)
   A. must copy a story
   B. gives you a topic and you decide the story
   C. has no words
   D. has only one correct answer

3. Narratives: Which sentence has a simile? (1 mark)
   A. The bread was soft.
   B. Bread is food.
   C. The bread was as soft as a pillow.
   D. We ate bread.

4. Which word has both the sounds /ɔɪ/ and /l/? (1 mark)
   A. oil
   B. boy
   C. road
   D. toy

5. What does 'thin' mean? (1 mark)
   A. very fat
   B. very tall
   C. With little flesh on the body
   D. very old

6. Which adverb of frequency completes: 'I ____ wash my hands before eating.' (every time)? (1 mark)
   A. seldom
   B. never
   C. rarely
   D. always

7. The word 'the' is said as 'thee' before (1 mark)
   A. a consonant sound
   B. a vowel sound
   C. a name
   D. a plural only

8. What should Neema do if a message frightens her? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it secret
   B. Share her password
   C. Reply
   D. Show a grown-up at once

9. Which word begins with the cluster 'cl'? (1 mark)
   A. print
   B. green
   C. brush
   D. clean

10. What is the comparative of 'bad'? (1 mark)
   A. more bad
   B. badder
   C. worst
   D. worse

11. Why should water from rivers be boiled before drinking? (1 mark)
   A. It tastes sweet
   B. It is too cold
   C. It may contain germs
   D. It is too clear

12. Which is the correct spelling of the evening meal? (1 mark)
   A. diner
   B. dinner
   C. dinnar
   D. dinnner

13. In a written dialogue, the speaker's name is usually followed by (1 mark)
   A. a colon
   B. nothing
   C. a full stop only
   D. a bracket

14. Intonation is (1 mark)
   A. the spelling of a word
   B. a kind of computer
   C. the length of a word
   D. the rise and fall of the voice

15. What is compost made from, according to Mama Neema? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetable peelings and dry leaves
   B. Cement and sand
   C. Maize flour
   D. Plastic and stones

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write a narrative of about 60 words about a visit to a farm. Include a beginning, a middle, an end and a simile. (5 marks)

17. Put the adjectives in the right order: a (red, round, big) balloon. (2 marks)

18. Rewrite in the past tense: 'I watch a video and I learn a new word.' (2 marks)

19. Replace the second mention with a pronoun: 'Neema saw the bridge. Neema liked the bridge.' (2 marks)

20. Write two words with the sound /aɪ/ and use one in a sentence. (2 marks)

21. Give a situation in which 'Prevention is better than cure' applies. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — mother
   'Mother' has the short /ʌ/.

2. B — gives you a topic and you decide the story
   You use your own ideas to complete it.

3. C — The bread was as soft as a pillow.
   It compares bread with a pillow using as ... as.

4. A — oil
   Oil has /ɔɪ/ followed by /l/.

5. C — With little flesh on the body
   Thin is the opposite of plump.

6. D — always
   'Always' means every time.

7. B — a vowel sound
   We say thee egg and thuh boy.

8. D — Show a grown-up at once
   A trusted adult can help.

9. D — clean
   'Clean' begins with c and l.

10. D — worse
   Bad, worse, worst.

11. C — It may contain germs
   Boiling kills germs.

12. B — dinner
   Dinner has a double n.

13. A — a colon
   For example: Baraka: I miss Grandmother.

14. D — the rise and fall of the voice
   It is the tune of our voice.

15. A — Vegetable peelings and dry leaves
   Compost heaps are made of peelings and dry leaves.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: A story of about 60 words in the past tense with clear parts and a simile.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the beginning, 1 for events in order, 1 for the end, 1 for a simile, 1 for correct tense and punctuation.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: a big round red balloon
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for size first and 1 mark for shape before colour.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: I watched a video and I learned (learnt) a new word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for watched, 1 mark for learned/learnt.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Neema saw the bridge. She liked it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for she and 1 mark for it.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: kite, night. I fly my kite on Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct words and 1 mark for a correct sentence.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Washing hands before eating prevents illness, which is better than getting sick and needing medicine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a situation and 1 for linking it to the proverb.
